titles.title: The Saint Who Blooms Beyond Time
時を超え咲き誇る聖女

description:
The land of Franchera is shaken by a long, unending war. Guided by the voice of divine oracles, village girl Jeanne has repeatedly averted the deaths of herself and those dear to her from drawing too near. 

Yet she bears another secret: every time she or someone precious to her dies, time rewinds, allowing her to redo fate itself. Haunted by the regret of failing to save her companions and the endless cycle of death and battle, Jeanne takes up the sword after many returns, determined to carve out the “future she must protect.” 

Can she defeat the cloaked figures who stand in her way and become a being worthy of truly being called a “saint”…?
